// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=CsvHelper&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/CsvHelperTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=CsvHelper&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using CsvHelper;
using System.Globalization;

// Verify.CsvHelper: Normalizes csv snapshots through CsvHelper, with per column ignore, scrub and translate hooks.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.CsvHelper
// Note: The fluent form on a verification is TranslateCsvColumn, singular, while the form on a
// VerifySettings is TranslateCsvColumns.
// Note: Reading and rewriting the csv normalizes quoting and line endings, so existing verified
// files can shift once when this is adopted.
// Note: The package is pre 1.0, and is not strong named.
public class CsvHelperTests
{
    // The csv is read and written again through CsvHelper before it is compared, so quoting and
    // escaping are normalized, and guids and dates are replaced with Verify's stable counters.
    [Fact]
    public Task Csv()
    {
        var csv = BuildCsv();
        return Verify(csv, "csv");
    }

    // The column is dropped from the snapshot entirely, for one that carries nothing worth
    // reviewing, such as an export timestamp.
    [Fact]
    public Task IgnoreColumns()
    {
        var csv = BuildCsv();
        return Verify(csv, "csv")
            .IgnoreCsvColumns("Dob");
    }

    // The column stays, with every value replaced by a placeholder, so the snapshot still shows
    // that the column was produced and how many rows had a value.
    [Fact]
    public Task ScrubColumns()
    {
        var csv = BuildCsv();
        return Verify(csv, "csv")
            .ScrubCsvColumns("Name");
    }

    // The outer call is asked once per column and returns the transform for that column, or null
    // to leave it alone, so only the columns that need normalizing pay for it.
    [Fact]
    public Task TranslateColumn()
    {
        var csv = BuildCsv();
        return Verify(csv, "csv")
            .TranslateCsvColumn(
                _ =>
                {
                    if (_ != "Name")
                    {
                        return null;
                    }

                    return value => value?.ToUpperInvariant();
                });
    }

    // A CsvReader is verified directly, for code that already has one open rather than a string
    // or a file.
    [Fact]
    public Task Reader()
    {
        var csv = BuildCsv();
        using var reader = new StringReader(csv);
        using var csvReader = new CsvReader(reader, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        return Verify(csvReader);
    }

    // The csv the samples verify. Real code would read a file instead: VerifyFile("sample.csv").
    static string BuildCsv() =>
        """
        Id,Name,Dob
        1,Sam,2000-01-01T00:00:00Z
        2,Mary,2001-02-03T00:00:00Z
        """;
}
